CustomField.description: Which side the counterparty on this NDA is, on an off-market disposition. Added 2026-08-09 (Part 2 lines 113-117). Before this field, NDA__c carried only Counterparty_Name__c (free Text), so the question the release gate depends on - "has the introducing broker's NDA come back, as well as the buyer's?" - was not queryable at all, only readable by eye. It is EXPOSED ON THE Disposition_NDA RECORD TYPE ONLY, where Buyer is the default; the Acquisition_NDA record type enumerates both values (a record type cannot expose an empty picklist) but sets NO default and the field is off the acquisition layout, because on an acquisition DPEG is itself the buyer and stamping Buyer here would name US - the same meaning inversion ARCHITECTURE.md records for Ball_In_Court__c on a disposition. Not a status field, so no Status suffix (ARCHITECTURE.md rule 7).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: On a disposition NDA, say who this counterparty is: the prospective Buyer, or the Introducing Broker who brought them. One NDA record per party - DPEG collects and counter-signs both, and nothing is released until every one is Signed.
CustomField.label: Party Role
